note: A dated record of supply, not a pin: Wikidata changes daily.

cities_over_one_million_with_a_populatio.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q515 ; wdt:P1082 ?p . FILTER(?p > 1000000) }

competition_series_with_5_editions_namin.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?series WHERE { ?ed wdt:P3450 ?series ; wdt:P1346 ?w . } GROUP BY ?series HAVING (COUNT(?ed) >= 5) } }

competition_series_with_a_winner_named_s.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?series) AS ?n) WHERE { ?ed wdt:P3450 ?series ; wdt:P1346 ?w ; wdt:P585 ?t . FILTER(YEAR(?t) >= 2021) }

conjectures_recording_who_proved_them.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?n) WHERE { ?x wdt:P31 wd:Q319141 ; wdt:P1318 ?proved . }
